title: ENDEX: Incident Closed — Hot Wash Initiated

fields.resolution: ENDEX. All systems are preserved. The UAS-11 incident is closed. The GCS has been re-imaged, the baseline verified, and the fleet restored under controlled conditions. The FAA FSDO, client, and managed SOC have been notified. The hot wash begins now.
finalState: UAS-11 remains in manual/attitude mode on the meadow.
The GCS-01 radio state and firmware are preserved.
The 915 MHz link is quarantined and re-keyed via HUOG-FW01.
The FSDO and CP&L program office have been updated on incident status.
The incident log is closed and archived under HUOG-ERP-2026-1022-09.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. The exercise has concluded. Please place your devices and logs on the table. We will now begin the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things to fix
hotWashQuestions: What was the most effective action taken during the incident response?
How could communication between the RPIC and ASO have been improved during the flight risk window?
What was the impact of delayed data verification on client confidence?
How did the team manage the balance between technical integrity and regulatory compliance?
What changes would you recommend to the HUOG-ISP Section 9.1 playbook based on this event?
